head: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: modular pixel-art baseball BLANK HEAD atlas for the exact existing simplified green uniform character in reference2. Four identical-sized bald peach heads ONLY, no bodies. 1024x1024,2columns2rows, four512pxcells. In each cell a64x72logicalpixel-style head, enlarged into about180px wide so pixel clusters are very visible, centered with abundant TRANSPARENT padding. Each head is the same original character skull/ears/short4px-wide neck ending in a FLAT horizontal attachment line. Row1 LEFT: FRONT view (two ears symmetric). Row1 RIGHT: FRONT-RIGHT threequarter facingright (near ear, slight far cheek). Row2 LEFT: REAR-RIGHT threequarter facingright, mostly back of bald skull with near ear. Row2 RIGHT: straight BACK view (ears symmetric, visible back of neck). Blank skin only, NO eyes/eyebrows/nose/mouth/hair/cap/helmet/markings. Same16x16 logical head shape, short2logicalpixel neck below, overall16x18 includingneck. Skin3tones peach, brown crisp pixel outline matchingreference. These are head bases for attaching later facial parts. No actual face. Coarse square pixel clusters, no antialias/airbrush or gradients. Actual transparent alpha0 background, opaque head pixels. NO text/grid/frame/shadows/logos. Original design. Do not draw clothes or shoulders.
normal: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: pixel-art BODY-ONLY modular skeleton atlas, based on the existing normal athletic2.5-head baseball character inreference2, and FIRST normal body ofreference1. 1536x1024,6columns4rows,24even256pxcells. Exactly24 **HEADLESS bodies**: torso, neck stub, arms,hands,legs,shoes. NO HEAD/NO skull/NO ears/NO facialparts/NO hair/NO cap; the large blank head will be attached separately in software at the flat peach neck socket. Keep a tiny exposed peach neck at the collar, flat top. Green short-sleeve jersey whitecuffs, whitepants, greensocks,charcoal shoes. Chunky pixel blocks asreference, no painterly soft edges, no text/logos/numbers. Each cell: virtual64x64grid, shoes ground y58logical=232px, centralbody x32logical=128px, about22logical pixels=88px from necktop to shoes (the head is NOT included in this height). Bodywidth17logical≈68px. Do not fill the cell with an oversized torso. Keep generous transparent gutters so all bats fit. Same normal torso and limb proportions across24 poses. Row1: (0) frontneutral, (1) front-rightthreequarterneutral, (2) rear-rightthreequarterneutral, (3) backneutral, (4) rightwardwalkheelstrike, (5) rightwardwalkpassing. Row2: (6) rightwardwalkpushoff, (7) oppositeheelstrike, (8) oppositepassing, (9) oppositepushoff, (10) front-right squat/kneesbend, (11) front-right slight forwardbow. Row3: six rightwardrunning cycle poses, rear-rightthreequarter. Row4: (18) right-handedbatready (barrelupLEFT), (19) coil/load, (20) contactbatRIGHT, (21) followthrough, (22) lowerbat, (23) neutralstandingemptyhands. All are headless bodies; NO floating head above anybody. The neck socket may translate/tilt with body. Keep art ABOVE/BELOW neck empty for commonhead later. Background TRUEalpha0 transparent with opaque sprite pixels, no shadow or ground.
